decision_rules.evaluated_on: pilot: full sample (this is not the final test-split decision, which follows the protocol)

rule1_acceptable_for_prototype.note: failure rate is over ALL valid images; 'fully visible face' is not annotated, so it cannot be restricted

rule2_post_processing_or_geometry_fix.roll_from_wp3: Update from the robustness suite (WP3, 100 dev images): roll of +/-30 deg costs 0.12-0.16 IoU and +/-45 deg costs 0.35-0.54 while detection stays 97-99%, so the roll item of rule 2 IS met; a roll-aligned crop is a WP6 candidate and needs user approval.
triggers: lips: consistent best shift (median dx +0, dy +2 px)
eye: consistent best shift (median dx +0, dy +1 px)
brow: consistent best shift (median dx +0, dy +2 px)

rule3_model_replacement_or_fine_tuning.caveat: Caveat: no trigger fires on the headline numbers, but the glasses stratum (eye IoU 0.00, n=48) and the alignment-failure stratum (eye IoU 0.168, n=93) are very poor; all 48 glasses images are among the 93 alignment failures. The fine-tuning / replacement decision is NOT made here; it is owed to the user.

decision_rules.rule5_licence: Regardless of the outcome, the CelebAMask-HQ model is replaced before any commercial release; this harness is the comparison tool for that replacement.
